verdict: Pisang goreng (banana fritters) is lower in calories, but keropok lekor has four times the protein. If you stick to 5 pieces, keropok lekor is more filling.
why: 5 pieces of keropok lekor are an estimated ~250 kcal, 2 pieces of pisang goreng ~200 kcal. Lekor is about 50 kcal higher.
Lekor has 9 g protein compared to 2 g for pisang goreng. This is because lekor is made from fish.
Fat is about the same: 11 g for lekor, 8 g for pisang goreng.
Lekor is easy to overeat because it's sold by the full plate with sauce. Count pieces, not plates.
when_a: Keropok lekor suits you when you're really hungry in the afternoon and dinner is still a long way off.
when_b: Pisang goreng is okay when you just want something a bit sweet and you're not that hungry.
tip: Order a plate of lekor to share, and take 5 pieces onto your own plate. Dip lightly in the sauce, don't soak it.

faq.a: Boiled lekor is usually lower in fat because it isn't fried. If there's a boiled option, it's an easy way to save calories.

faq.q: Is keropok lekor sauce high in calories?
faq.a: Sweet chilli sauce has sugar, an estimated 20-50 kcal depending on how much you dip. Use a little, and choose a less sweet one if available.
